description.value:
Check Intimidation vs. target's Will DC

Effect off-guard against your next attack, plus a −2 status penalty (Skilled) on their next save against fear

Put a fist through drywall, flip a table, crush something the mark cares about.

cinderfall.incomplete: The off-guard portion needs no rule element (real pf2e ships condition-only outcomes as "rules": [], e.g. feint.json) and is applied manually via the description. The -2 status penalty on the target's next fear save is a stated number on an external target -- needs the distracting-feint.json/effect-distracting-feint.json two-file companion-effect pattern, outside this card's scope. Left INCOMPLETE for that penalty; the off-guard part needs no fix.
